title: Bryce Young fully participates in Panthers practice, but Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette sit out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bryce Young fully participates in Panthers practice, but Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette sit out
sources.description: The Panthers placed their starting cornerbacks on injured reserve on Wednesday, but there was a positive development for quarterback Bryce Young later in the day.
